seoTitle: How to Import Excel Data Into Jotform Tables
metaDescription: Learn how to import an Excel or CSV file into Jotform Tables in 2026, mapping headers and formatting fields to build a new data tracking sheet.
intro: Consolidating spreadsheet records into a live, trackable database is easy with Jotform Tables' import feature, which turns an Excel or CSV file into a working table in minutes. This guide covers uploading your file, setting the first row as column headers, and confirming field types before completing the import.

steps.heading: Open My Tables
steps.body: Navigate to your workspace dashboard and switch to the My Tables panel.

steps.heading: Start a data import
steps.body: Click Create Table and select the Import Data option to begin the process.

steps.heading: Upload your file
steps.body: Drag and drop your Excel or CSV file into the upload zone.

steps.heading: Set column headers
steps.body: Toggle the option to use the first row as column headers so Jotform extracts field names automatically.

steps.heading: Verify field types and import
steps.body: Check that columns are correctly typed as text, numbers, or dates, then click Import to generate your new digital table.

faq.question: Can I import a CSV file, or only Excel spreadsheets?
faq.answer: Both Excel and CSV files are supported for import into Jotform Tables.

faq.question: Can I import data into an existing table instead of creating a new one?
faq.answer: Yes, you can add a new data import view tab inside an existing table as an alternative to creating a standalone sheet.

faq.question: What happens if my spreadsheet doesn't have headers in the first row?
faq.answer: You can leave the header toggle off, and Jotform will treat the first row as data rather than field names, though renaming columns manually afterward is recommended.

faq.question: Will imported data automatically match existing form field types?
faq.answer: You need to review and adjust field types like text, number, or date during import, since Jotform doesn't always detect them perfectly on its own.
